afterself.consent.prompt: [Afterself] Souls can repeat short clips of your real voice, even long after you said them, and can imitate you to other players. Clips are saved on this server's disk until you refuse, and whoever runs the server can access them. Allow it?
afterself.consent.accepted: [Afterself] Voice clips allowed. Turn them off at any time with /afterself voice refuse.
afterself.consent.refused: [Afterself] Voice clips refused, and your clips were erased from the disk. Souls can still hear how loud you are.
afterself.consent.forgotten: [Afterself] Your voice clips were erased from the disk.
afterself.consent.status_off: [Afterself] Your voice clips are not allowed.
afterself.command.count: [Afterself] Your souls: %s awake, %s waiting for the night. Voice clips stored for you: %s.
afterself.command.no_clip: [Afterself] This soul's owner has no recorded voice clip, or Voice Chat is not running.
afterself.command.no_haunt: [Afterself] Not possible here: no door, chest or voice clip in reach, or no room behind you.
afterself.command.kit: [Afterself] The soul received blocks, a sword, a shield, a bow, pearls and bread.
afterself.warning.login: [Afterself] Try not to die too often. Every death leaves a soul that will ruin every one of your nights and steal from your chests.
afterself.warning.login_one: [Afterself] Try not to die too often. One of your souls is already waiting: it will ruin every one of your nights and steal from your chests. Every death adds another.
afterself.warning.login_souls: [Afterself] Try not to die too often. %s of your souls are already waiting: they will ruin every one of your nights and steal from your chests. Every death adds another.
